title: The faders don't change the room
intro: Look at the buttons above the faders: they decide what the faders control.

complaints.says: I pushed the Handheld fader up, but nothing changed in the room.

win.label: Faders back on Main
win.hint: Click Main above the faders. You were adjusting Mix 3 (the keys wedge).

win.label: Host loud enough in the mains
win.hint: In Main mode, bring the Handheld fader up to around -10.

hints: Read the orange banner above the faders.
cause: The mixer was left in Mix 3 mode, so the faders were changing the keys wedge instead of the room. The Handheld fader in Main was also down.
lesson: Always check which mix is selected before moving faders. After building a monitor mix, go straight back to Main.
